definitions.ask: Should Capture's targets watcher also skip batches that touch only dot paths (.git/, .obsidian/, .trash/)?
definitions.why: Refresh-on-every-batch is a deliberate Capture contract; change it in its own review

choices.label: Only Refs changes; Capture still runs capture-targets twice every ~16 s during vault sync
Capture's targets refresh also skips dot-path-only batches, ending that churn too
